links.outcome: Report drafting speed and completeness at external sites without site-specific fine-tuning
links.effect: Without site-specific fine-tuning, chest report drafting was 29.6% faster and abdominal report completeness improved 11.3% among junior and mid-level radiologists (P<0.001).
links.quote: Deployed at external clinical sites without any site-specific fine-tuning, Astra accelerated chest report drafting by 29.6% and improved abdominal report completeness by 11.3% among junior and mid-level radiologists (P<0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a foundation model for 3D CT report generation, evaluated both on benchmarks and deployed with junior and mid-level radiologists to assess drafting efficiency and report completeness.
